title: Continuity of Care Schedule: Late-Request Cut for Prior Authorization Transition Units
content:
**Schedule rule.** The late-request cut of a transition-of-care request counts the days from the member's plan coverage start date to the day the request is recorded: from the seventy-sixth day on, four units are cut; from the forty-sixth through the seventy-fifth day, two units are cut; through the forty-fifth day, nothing is cut.

The coverage start date is the one on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership. The count runs in calendar days: the day after the coverage start date is day 1, and the day the request is recorded is the last day counted. The cut is subtracted once from the units a Prior Authorization transition-of-care request asks for, before the ceiling of the class's most units per approval is applied. The floor of zero is applied once, to the figure that results after the ceiling, and never to the cut taken on its own.

*Hypothetical placement:* where the units a request asks for would come to 3 without this cut and the cut is 4 units, the subtraction leaves less than nothing, so the request asks for 0 units. Where the figure before the ceiling would be 22 without this cut, in a class whose most units per approval is 20, the cut of 4 gives 18, which is under the ceiling, so the request asks for 18 units.

## Cut schedule

| Day count on the day the request is recorded | Units cut |
|---|---|
| 45 or fewer | 0 |
| 46 through 75 | 2 |
| 76 or more | 4 |

## Boundary days (hypothetical dates)

For a hypothetical coverage start date of 1 January in a year that is not a leap year:

| Request recorded on | Day count | Units cut |
|---|---|---|
| 15 February | 45 | 0 |
| 16 February | 46 | 2 |
| 17 March | 75 | 2 |
| 18 March | 76 | 4 |

The cut depends only on the day count; the service, the class and the units on the earlier approval play no part in it.
